name: halkliff-review
description: Explicit reviews with independent evidence, quality assessments, and a local HTML report.

interface.longDescription: Run the bundled review-work workflow, record independent review evidence, and render a local HTML report with the included Python helper.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-work-plugin once to assess this implementation and its relevant effects against the approved requirements. Offer the review defaults for roles I leave unspecified. Create useful coordinator chats using gpt-6.2-astra at High by default, with my scoped choices taking precedence. Coordinate scoped messages among them under this request. Preserve my checkout and data, keep reviewer code writes in reviewer-owned clones or worktrees, and return the offline report and work-chat handoff without repairs. Recover existing context and confirm any missing material setup. Create a goal only if I explicitly request one.
